run_fast_acute_evaluation: run a fast ACUTE-Eval comparison of two or more dialogue models using the FastAcuteBlueprint
configure_fast_acute_blueprint_args: configure FastAcuteBlueprintArgs with model pairs, matchups per pair, and self-chat parameters for evaluation
review_fast_acute_blueprint: review the FastAcuteBlueprint class and its ArgsClass dataclass to understand ACUTE-Eval configuration options
summarize_fast_acute_blueprint_args: summarize the FastAcuteBlueprintArgs dataclass fields including config_path, root_dir, models, and model_pairs
refactor_fast_acute_blueprint: refactor the FastAcuteBlueprint subclass to add new evaluation parameters or override parent blueprint methods
